messages:
Nadia (Partnerships): Heads-up: NovaEdge uploaded a signed PO but the portal flagged vendor entity vs EIN mismatch (portal sees "NovaEdge, Inc" / EIN 55-1112223 but vendor submitted "NovaEdge Solutions LLC" / EIN 55-1112223). Procurement rejected for entity name mismatch. We need a short path to enable the integration for a partner demo Friday. Thoughts?
Hugo (Procurement): System rejects on legal name mismatch even if EIN matches. Policy requires corrected PO or a vendor attestation on letterhead linking the names. We can provisionally accept with an attestation + procurement approval, but only for 48 hours.
marketplace-bot: ingestion status -> REJECTED: vendor_name_mismatch. {"ticket":"MP-100221","expected":"NovaEdge, Inc","received":"NovaEdge Solutions LLC"}
Riley (CSM): Vendor says US finance uploaded the wrong template from their UK entity. They can re-upload corrected PO but earliest is tomorrow EOD. Can Procurement allow a 48h provisional enable to unblock demo?
Mina (Legal): Minimal risk approach: attestation + signature from authorized officer + clause confirming same EIN and that signatory has authority. I can draft a 1-pager attestation. If signed, legal clears provisional. No product billing until docs resolved.
Ken (Finance): Even with attestation I need the legal name to match for invoicing. I can create a "provisional billing bucket" (PROV-NOVA-01) that holds invoicing mapping but payments will not be released until vendor registration is corrected. Is that acceptable?
Sam (Sales): We need the integration toggled for live demo Friday 10am PT. If we get attestation by tomorrow morning, can Partnerships flip the toggle? Sales will notify customer that invoices may be delayed due to onboarding.
Hugo (Procurement): Agrees to 48h provisional enable if: 1) signed attestation attached to MP-100221, 2) Legal signs off, 3) Finance sets provisional bucket. We'll set status PROVISIONAL_ENABLED in the portal.
Mina (Legal): Drafting attestation now. Attestation will include: vendor legal names, EIN, signatory name/title, explicit statement of equivalence, cure timeline (5 business days). DocuSign preferred. Posting to ticket in 30m.
Riley (CSM): Pushing vendor for DocuSign. AE confirmed they can get signatory online tomorrow morning.
Ken (Finance): Once attestation attached I will create PROV-NOVA-01 and mark payments HOLD. Notify me in thread when attached.
Nadia (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Mina post attestation template, 2) Riley get DocuSign signed attestation, 3) Hugo mark portal PROVISIONAL_ENABLED on attach, 4) Ken create provisional bucket. If attestation not attached by 9am PT tomorrow, Sales will reschedule demo.
Sam (Sales): Noted. I'll advise the customer and keep backup demo slot.
Riley (CSM): Vendor committed to DocuSign by 8:30am PT tomorrow. Will update ticket MP-100221 when complete. :pray:
